access.noActiveClub: No active club was found for this account.
access.checkFailed: Could not check club access status.
access.cannotPlay: This club cannot be played right now.

restartWelcome.title: Welcome back to your restarted team
restartWelcome.subtitle: Your club has been given a fresh start.
restartWelcome.body1: Your team is active again with a new starter squad, starter equipment, starter finances, and 0 season points.
restartWelcome.body2: Your club name, logo, jersey, country, and competition slot have been preserved. The old riders were released as free agents, and the club is ready for a new beginning.
restartWelcome.goodLuck: Good luck this time. Build carefully, manage the budget, and bring your club back stronger.

liquidation.label: Club Liquidated
liquidation.title: {{club}} has been liquidated
liquidation.description: This club used all 3 lifetime emergency rescues and then failed to cover another mandatory obligation. No further emergency loans are available, and this team can no longer perform game actions.
liquidation.accountNotice: Your user account and coins are still active. Only this club is closed. You can create a completely new club in the next available free spot, or restart this team in the same competition slot with a fresh squad, no staff, and 0 points.
liquidation.identityTitle: Restart Team keeps your club identity.
liquidation.identityBody: Your club ID, owner account, team name, logo, jersey, country, and tier/division slot stay the same. Current riders are released to the free-agent market, all season points are reset to 0, and the club receives a new starter squad based on its current competition tier.

restartModal.confirmExact: You must type RESTART exactly to confirm this action.
restartModal.unexpected: Failed to restart team due to an unexpected error.
restartModal.title: Confirm Team Restart
restartModal.subtitle: This will reset your club back to a fresh starter state.
restartModal.intro: Restart Team keeps your club identity and competition slot, but it resets the sporting and gameplay state of the team.
restartModal.loseRiders: Current riders, who become free agents
restartModal.loseGameplay: Training, scouting, transfer, and race-preparation state
restartModal.after: After restart, your team receives a new starter squad based on its current competition tier, starter equipment, starter infrastructure, and zero season points.

rollover.title: Season {{season}} is being prepared
rollover.body: The season rollover is currently in progress. Your club and game data are safe while the new season is finalized.
rollover.noAction: No action is required. Gameplay is temporarily locked while promotion and relegation, contracts, sponsors, rewards, rankings, the calendar, and final validation are processed.
rollover.autoCheck: This page checks the rollover automatically every 20 seconds and returns you to the game when it is complete.
rollover.delayedTitle: The rollover is taking longer than expected
rollover.delayedBody: The game will remain safely frozen until every required validation passes. Your club data is not being skipped or partially released.
rollover.statusCheckFailedBody: We cannot safely confirm whether gameplay is available right now. The page will keep retrying automatically.

inactivity.title: You will be logged out soon
inactivity.body: Your game has been inactive for almost 30 minutes. You will be logged out automatically in approximately one minute.
